method.scope: Public clients plus actual installed native ASR worker; warm filesystem cache, fresh worker/model links and private caches each session; no GUI, microphone or user content. PID numbers remain in the host namespace for independent NVML ownership, only this driver and guarded descendants are observed/signalled. Private network/mount/device/home/passwd isolate caches and desktop. Client startup excluded; first recognition includes worker/import/model initialization, later calls reuse it. Native driver has two app-equivalent provider threads; worker ORT/BLAS thread limits are the unchanged production settings.
